preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 40 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 10000 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(K, int) and 1 <= K <= 10**9 for K in test_cases_K)
preconditions.description: For each test case, K is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases_N))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= K for x in line.split()) for line, K in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases_K))
postconditions.description: Every integer in the output for a test case is between 1 and K inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(max_xor(line, K) == max_possible_xor(N, K) for line, N, K in zip(stdout_lines, test_cases_N, test_cases_K))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the bitwise XOR of the output integers equals the maximum possible XOR achievable by any sequence of N integers in the range [1, K].
